inactive.title: Personality profile inactive
inactive.description: Your personality profile is suspended or pending. Meanwhile the portal is read only: you cannot create content, suggest links or edit the profile.
inactive.descriptionNamed: The profile of {name} is suspended or pending. Meanwhile the portal is read only: you cannot create content, suggest links or edit the profile.

unlinked.title: Account without a personality profile
unlinked.description: Your account has the personality role but is not linked to an active profile. Accept the invitation you received by email or contact the administration.

unavailable.help: Questions? Contact the Ultra Hero editorial team. Remember: personalities on this platform are fictional and this is a demo environment.

edit.accessNote: Access rule, module, featuring and publishing are set by the administration. You edit title, summary, cover, metadata and the body.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Edit freely. When complete, submit it for review.

in_review.title: Under review
in_review.description: The editorial team is evaluating it. The content stays locked until a decision.

returned.title: Returned for changes
returned.description: Read the feedback, adjust the draft and submit it for review again.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: The editorial team did not approve this version. You can revise the draft and submit it again.

published.title: Published
published.description: This content is live and is now read only for you. Changes go through the administration.

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Content archived by the administration. It stays read only.

edit.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed or belong to another personality.

submit.title: Submit for editorial review?
submit.description: The content stays locked for editing until the team decides. The checklist considers what is already saved.

reviews.title: Review history
reviews.description: Each submission opens a round; the team's decision and feedback appear here.
reviews.emptyDescription: When you submit content, the history appears here.

links.description: Suggest demo-store products related to your content. Illustrative prices; no real purchases.
links.how1: You suggest; the administration validates or rejects. Only validated links are shown to the public.
links.how2: If the supplier makes a significant change to the product (title, category, type, attributes or food information), the validated link is suspended automatically until revalidated.
links.how3: You can delete a suggestion while it has not been evaluated yet.
links.contentHint: One of your content items (any status except archived).
links.noContents: Create a content item before suggesting links.
links.searchHint: Search by title among published, available products.
links.noResults: No purchasable product with that title.
links.noteHint: Why this product fits the content (optional).
links.suggestedDescription: The administration will evaluate the link.
links.tableCaption: Links suggested by me and their statuses
links.emptyDescription: Use the form above to suggest the first link.
links.deleteDescription: The suggestion for "{product}" will be removed. You can suggest it again later.
